comment: make the dots aligned and stick to the element when scrolling and fix a common problem that some jynx overlayes are above the nav bar in z index so its just all over the place when scrolling, like the dots. or hover effects etc...
resolutionNote: Fixed directly: (1) dots lagging during fast scroll -- the scroll listener did an unthrottled setState per native scroll event; now collapsed to at most one recompute per animation frame (AdminAnnotationMarkers.jsx and CommentsPanel.jsx). (2) dots floating over the sticky topbar/sidebar for elements scrolled underneath them -- new shared stickyChromeBounds.js hides a dot whenever its target rect overlaps .app-topbar/.app-sidebar, since the target itself is visually hidden there too.
